name: New York City
title: Which NYC Airport Should You Fly Into From Albany?
detailHtml:
Flying out of the New York City area but not sure which airport makes sense? JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark all serve Manhattan and the surrounding boroughs, and we provide reliable car service to and from all three. Call our dispatcher anytime at (518) 327-0700 — we're happy to help you weigh the options for your specific flight.

  • See our dedicated JFK car service page for John F. Kennedy International — about 155 miles / 3 hours from Albany.
  • See our dedicated LaGuardia car service page for LGA — about 160 miles / 3 hours from Albany.
  • See our dedicated Newark car service page for EWR — about 150 miles / 2 hr 45 min from Albany, typically the shortest of the three.
  • Traveling the full distance between Albany and New York City itself, rather than through one of its airports? See our Albany to NYC route page for round-trip pricing.

Drive times are typical estimates and vary with traffic, weather, and time of day.

The price you're quoted is what you pay, even if we hit traffic or your flight's delayed.

mdesc: Comparing JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark from Albany — we provide car service to and from all three New York City-area airports. Door-to-door, 24/7.
